column1: # Passages: several sentences read as one connected text (spec §16).
# The sentences themselves live in the sentences-*.tsv files and carry the
# passage key in their `passage` column, so a paragraph stays together in the
# file a human is reading and each of its sentences stays practisable on its own.
# `kind` is text or dialogue; a dialogue needs a speaker on every line.
# Leave the id off a new row: the build assigns one and writes it back.
